_doc: Materials & Components — cathode/anode active materials, chemicals. Keyed by cleaned-name token; see ENRICHMENT_PROMPT.md.

posco future m.one_liner: Korean cathode & anode materials arm of POSCO (formerly POSCO Chemical).

basf.one_liner: Chemicals major supplying cathode active materials and battery chemicals.

novonix.one_liner: Synthetic graphite anode + battery test-equipment maker.

sila.one_liner: Silicon anode material; founded by ex-Tesla engineer Gene Berdichevsky.

group14.one_liner: Silicon-carbon anode (SCC55); JV with SK and Porsche.

sumitomo metal mining.one_liner: Japanese mining & smelting group; also a major cathode-materials producer (JV with Panasonic).

l&f.one_liner: Korean cathode-materials maker; NCM/NCA supplier to LG Energy Solution and others.

btr new material.one_liner: Chinese anode and cathode materials maker; major supplier to CATL and other Chinese cell makers.

resonac.one_liner: Japanese materials group formed from the merger of Showa Denko and Hitachi Chemical; carbon/graphite battery materials.

mitsubishi chemical.one_liner: Japanese chemicals group; carbon anode materials for Li-ion cells.

johnson matthey.one_liner: UK chemicals/catalysis group; explored cathode active materials (eLNO) before scaling back the battery-materials business in 2023.

asahi kasei.one_liner: Japanese chemicals group; Hipore wet-process separators, and owns US separator maker Celgard.

toray industries.one_liner: Japanese materials group; Li-ion battery separators alongside carbon-fiber materials.

sk ie technology.one_liner: Korean separator maker, spun off from SK Innovation's materials business in 2019.

sgl carbon.one_liner: German carbon and graphite materials group.

toda kogyo.one_liner: Japanese chemicals maker; cathode active materials for Li-ion cells.

shanshan technology.one_liner: Chinese materials group supplying cathode, anode and electrolyte materials to major cell makers.

celgard.one_liner: US dry-process battery separator maker; subsidiary of Asahi Kasei.

ube corporation.one_liner: Japanese chemicals group; battery electrolytes and separators.

sumitomo chemical.one_liner: Japanese chemicals group; aramid-coated battery separators.

shenzhen capchem.one_liner: Chinese electrolyte maker and a major supplier to CATL and BYD.
